resources.string: What would you like to use in MapControl?
Your picks show up in the menu. Apps, Wi-Fi, Transfer and Settings are always there. This doesn\'t turn any setting off, and you can change it anytime.
Car info, music, climate and apps on one home screen.
Mirror the map to the driver display, split the screen.
Welcome sound and screen when the car starts.
Climate and sunroof adjust on their own.
Your drive mode is remembered on every start.
360° camera recordings and driver face recognition.
Raw vehicle data and sensor readings.
Turn on the Custom Car Launcher?
If you turn it on, the car\'s Home key opens the MapControl home screen. The car\'s own home screen stays; you can switch back anytime in Settings.
Yes, I want to use it
The Home key goes to the MapControl home screen.
The car\'s home screen stays; you can still set it up from the menu.
To change it: Settings › Edit menu.
Choose again which sections appear in the side menu with a short question.
